# Support

- **Usage questions & template ideas:** open a [Discussion](https://github.com/dcondrey/html-email/discussions).
- **Bugs (render/build/lint):** open an [issue](https://github.com/dcondrey/html-email/issues/new/choose).
- **Security:** see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) — report privately, not in a public issue.

Before filing a render bug, note the **client + platform** (e.g. Outlook 2019 / Windows, Gmail web,
Apple Mail on iOS 17) — email bugs are usually client-specific. Paste `lint.mjs` output when relevant.
